banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Submit competing promotions; only the valid lock/epoch owner may act.
preconditions: Two fixed sessions share training-destination at epoch 7 and blue-v1
Independent training-other lease has observer ownership, epoch 40 and purple-v4
actions: Choose first session and contender condition
Explicit reset clears all local data
fixture: Fixed records in model.js; alpha proposes green-v2, bravo proposes amber-v3
assertions: Only observed current owner with matching destination epoch may promote
Current epoch cannot bypass conflicting ownership
Transferred lock cannot bypass stale epoch
Serialized fresh owner may apply exactly once
Missing owner evidence is UNKNOWN without an effect
Unrelated lease is unchanged after every action
Applied, rejected and unknown counts sum to submitted commands
Prediction correctness is separate from command outcome
Failures and unknowns stay in retained denominators
history: Memory-only complete attempts, traces and predictions; no eviction; new attempt retains history; explicit reset or reload clears all data
stateGuards: idle -> first-ready -> contender-ready -> decided -> checked; exact plain enum record; strict action order and arity; returned snapshots cannot alter state
limits: Deterministic ordered records, not actual concurrent submissions or a distributed lock service
No native Azure result, production Node24 validation, source-parent completion or five-nines claim
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, spending, packages, framework changes or downloads
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical acceptance pending; one frozen S unit only; no extra test/plumbing/refinement credit
